//: The front door is Node, not a browser, and gets its own tsconfig so the two
worlds' globals stay apart. Adding @types/node to the ROOT config would put
Node's setTimeout (returns Timeout) and the DOM's (returns number) in the
same scope for every file in src/, which is a classic source of type errors
in code that was previously fine.
No DOM lib here on purpose: if a server module ever reaches for `document`
or `localStorage`, that is a real mistake and this is what catches it.
